name: keel
//pnpm.overrides: Transitive security pins, each clears Dependabot alerts the parent has not bumped for: next=min patched; tinypool<=2.1.1 (via vitest 3); glob@10 (via react-email); next>postcss (next pins 8.4.31); rollup@3 (via @sentry/nextjs); toml (via remark-mdx-frontmatter). Drop an entry once the parent ships a fixed range.

scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter api test:unit
scripts.design:check: npx --yes impeccable@4.1.0 detect --json apps/web/app apps/web/components packages/ui/src
scripts.e2e:baseline: node scripts/dev.mjs e2e e2e/accessibility.spec.ts e2e/auth-flows.spec.ts e2e/org-permissions.spec.ts e2e/cross-host-login.spec.ts
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && uv sync --frozen --directory apps/api && pnpm --filter @keel/emails build && pnpm --filter web content:build
